meta.name: true-or-false
meta.description: Make sure to use this skill whenever you need to align codebase reality with stated requirements, validate a user or data journey step-by-step, eliminate batch-generation hallucinations, or surface hidden bugs/dead code via a structured True/False evaluation loop.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 逐项核验代码与需求是否一致,揪出隐藏缺陷
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常需确认代码是否真正满足需求并找出潜在问题
copy.tagline_en: Validate code against stated requirements to reveal defects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to confirm code meets requirements and find hidden issues

howto.what: Claude 会把你要核对的目标流程拆成一连串检查点，每一步用通俗提问问你预期行为，并附上对应代码片段。你选 True 或 False 等选项后，它会推进、记录问题或跳过分支，最后给出验证摘要和待办清单。
howto.when: 当你需要核对代码实现与需求是否一致、逐步验证某个用户流程，或想排查隐藏 bug/死代码时，它会启动 True/False 评估循环。

say.text: 把从注册到下单的流程拆成步骤，逐项问我是否符合预期
say.note: Claude 会生成旅程地图并逐步提问

say.text: 用 True/False 方式检查这段代码与需求是否一致，不一致就记录
say.note: 遇到 False 会创建 backlog 条目

say.text: 逐步验证用户登录流程，跳过无关分支
say.note: 可用 Skip Branch 跳过废弃路径

howto.what_en: Claude breaks the target workflow into checkpoints, asks plain-language questions about expected behavior at each step, and shows the relevant code snippet. After you choose True/False, it advances, logs issues, or skips branches, then outputs a summary and backlog.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to align codebase reality with requirements, validate a user journey step-by-step, or surface hidden bugs/dead code through a True/False loop.

say_en.text: Break the flow from signup to checkout into steps and ask me if each matches expectations.
say_en.note: Claude generates a journey map and questions step by step.

say_en.text: Check this code against the requirements with True/False and log any mismatch.
say_en.note: A False answer creates a backlog entry.

say_en.text: Validate the login flow gradually and skip irrelevant branches.
say_en.note: Use Skip Branch to bypass deprecated paths.
